title: Customer lifeboat and targeted runtime serialization fix for intermittent 5xx/timeouts
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Summary: During a recent escalation from two enterprise tenants we observed recurring 5xx spikes and long tail timeouts in the Hosted API. Initial traces show a narrow failure mode in the runtime serialization path combined with delayed keepalive reuse under high tenant fanout. This ticket implements a short-lived "customer lifeboat" mitigation (behavioral runtime shim + admission controls) and a targeted serialization race fix to address root cause.

Background: On 2026-03-08 we started receiving customer escalation threads reporting transient 502/504 spikes and streaming hangs. The issue correlates with large multipart uploads and high concurrency from a few tenants. Symptoms: partial responses, socket hang until upstream timeout, then 5xx propagated. Abort/retry storms amplified the impact.

Hypothesis: A serialization race in the runtime path occasionally corrupts in-flight KV cache pointers when requests are admitted concurrently and connection keepalives are reused under the proxy. This leads to inconsistent request state that the router treats as a hard failure (5xx) or stalls until a hard timeout.

Goals: 1) Immediately reduce customer-visible errors and provide a rollback-safe mitigation (customer lifeboat). 2) Implement and land a small, well-scoped runtime serialization fix. 3) Harden retries and SDK guidance to avoid amplification. 4) Add targeted telemetry and a postmortem.

Planned work: - Implement lifeboat shim that:  * Enforces per-tenant admission limits on high-fanout multipart uploads.  * Applies a fast fallback to smaller model variant for priority tenants when serial failures detected.  * Adds transient retry hysteresis header and short-circuits non-idempotent retries. - Patch runtime to guard the serialization path (atomic swap + lightweight sequence guard) and add unit tests / fuzz harness. - Add end-to-end smoke tests in staging with synthetic tenant burst. - Deploy hotfix to a single region and monitor for 24h before global rollout.

Artifacts and links: Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HOST/ENG-412358+Lifeboat+Runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/12387 Dashboard (incident heatmap): https://app.datadog.com/dashboard/hosted/5xx-heatmap?incident=ENG-412358 Postmortem template: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lifecyclepostmortem
